QUOTE: "A single code can carry both parts." and "result: "HIGH : LOW", or whichever part exists" and "high = ret & 0xFF80 ... low = ret & ~0xFF80 ... append " : " if buffer has room"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that a code has a high-level module part and a low-level part, and that mbedtls_strerror looks up each part and joins them with " : " when both are present.
